# Academic calendars

Start planning ahead for your studies and understand the various dates for each teaching period

## Check out the UNSW academic calendars for all teaching modes

Whether you're studying in the Term, Semester or Hexamester mode, we've got the key dates for each academic period right here. Take note of when classes start, exams periods and when your holidays will take place.

#### See also

### Our academic calendar model is changing in 2028

After a comprehensive consultation process, we have come up with an improved teaching model that allows greater flexibility for students to pursue both academic and professional development.

Starting in 2028, our learning model will consist of **two 12-week teaching semesters** with a mid-semester break. This allows for two optional six-week summer and winter terms for short, intensive or catch-up courses.
